code_summary: One independent two-layer GRU model per category, with tied item embeddings and the existing softplus positive/negative objective. Adds float32 causal prefix means of nonpadding embeddings, LayerNorm, and a jointly trained fusion layer initialized to [I, 0] to preserve initial recurrent features. Retains training settings and validation-based checkpoint selection. Predictor checks architecture version and strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category; no ensemble or auxiliary fitted scorer.
